purpose: Define and analyze the intended integration boundary for CIC as a CW Toolkit component before any CIC implementation is moved into CW.

current_active_cw_set.authority_rule: CIC must conform to the active CW specification set. CIC must not own or redefine canonical CW semantics.

architectural_role.canonical_statement: CIC knows how to extract code into CW. CW Toolkit knows how CW is formed, validated and handled. Consumers know valid CW. Derived projections know only projections.
architectural_role.core_principle: One model. Many topologies. No duplicate truth.

cic_owns: cross-file source resolution needed for import
mapping extracted implementation evidence into canonical CW structures
consumer_must_not_own: source-code parsing required to reconstruct canonical CW semantics

required_chain: validate CW artifact against active canonical specification
validation_boundary.shared_validator_rule: CIC-produced CW and externally produced CW must pass the same canonical CW validation path before a consumer treats the model as valid.
validation_boundary.no_bypass_rule: CIC output must not receive trusted-internal acceptance solely because CIC produced it.

allowed_cic_local_checks: shard packaging integrity where CIC is the serializer

analysis_questions.question: Can the current CIC implementation be moved under CW Toolkit without importing Structure-specific semantics?
Does current CIC contain hardcoded CW semantic vocabulary that should instead be resolved from the active CW specification set?
Does current CIC output canonical CW or a CIC-specific approximation of CW?
Can current CIC validation be reduced to importer-local integrity while canonical semantic validation is delegated to the CW Toolkit validator stack?
Do all current CIC function, event, link, data, file and API mappings conform to the active CW Rulesets and NodeTypes without shadow schemas?
Is canonical structured function logic emitted at the location required by the active Dependency Rules rather than under importer-specific metadata?
Can any CW consumer use CIC output without knowing that CIC produced it?
Can CIC be removed or replaced without changing the canonical CW model or any consumer contract?

acceptance_criteria_for_future_move: CIC has no Structure-specific semantic dependency.
CIC emits CW conforming to the active CW specification set.
CIC does not hardcode canonical semantic vocabularies that belong to CW specifications.
CIC uses the shared CW Toolkit validation stack for canonical conformance.
CIC output and third-party CW output receive identical canonical validation treatment.
Consumers require only CW, not CIC internals or source code.
Derived projections remain non-authoritative and rebuildable from CW.
No duplicate semantic truth is introduced by the integration.
non_goals: Move current CIC implementation into CW now.
Change CW specifications to fit current CIC output.
Preserve importer-specific schemas merely for compatibility.
Make Structure part of CIC or CIC part of Structure.
decision_rule: CIC is ready to enter CW Toolkit only when it behaves as a replaceable source-to-CW adapter whose output is indistinguishable, at the canonical boundary, from valid CW produced by any other conforming producer.
